description: Wait server-side until the newest build of an app is finished AND the new version is serving traffic — use this INSTEAD of polling runzero_list_builds, sleeping, or re-checking the site in a loop. Blocks up to 45 seconds per call and returns {status: "success" | "failed" | "running", phase, rollout, builds}. "running" with phase "building" or "rolling-out" means: call it again. A rollout follows every successful build by 30-90 s, and until it lands the live URL, curl and screenshots still show the OLD version — do not push a fix for what you see in that window. "success" with phase "live" means every pod serves the new build; phase "done" means built but not live for a reason named in `hint` (the app publishes on request, an older version is pinned, not deployed yet). On "failed", read runzero_get_build_logs with the failed build id.

service.description: Only wait for this service (default: all services)

name: runzero_wait_for_build
title: Wait for build
